title: add-init-phase-state-tracing-and-conditional-nodeAffinity-values-schema
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added init-phase state tracing and optional node affinity configuration for init jobs. Values schema extended to validate affinity and tracing toggles. Minor docs and test additions. No runtime API changes.
description:
Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) occasionally require tighter control over where init jobs land and better visibility when init sequences stall during upgrades. This PR adds a light-weight init-phase 'state tracing' hook and a conditional nodeAffinity/nodeSelector values subtree so operators can pin init jobs to specific node classes without forking templates per environment.

What this change does (summary): - Introduces charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json additions to validate .initJobs.enableTracing and .initJobs.nodeAffinity.* keys. - Adds a small helper template (templates/_init_helpers.tpl) with a 'renderInitAffinity' function that renders affinity/selector only when values are present. - Reworks templates/init-hooks.yaml to emit an annotated init Job that writes ephemeral traces to a Helm-managed ConfigMap (traces expire on subsequent upgrades) so we can inspect stage/state without requiring external logging. - Adds templates/tests/init-job-test.yaml to exercise the nodeAffinity rendering and the tracing toggle under helm test. - Updates README with configuration examples and upgrade guidance.

Config example included in README: one-liner examples for enabling tracing and pinning to nodeLabel: node-role.kubernetes.io/storage: "true". The values subtree is intentionally opt-in (defaults disabled) to avoid surface area for existing installs.

Upgrade notes: This is additive. When enabling nodeAffinity for init jobs operators should verify node capacity for init waves (see notes in README). Traces are stored in a small ConfigMap named redwood-private-init-traces-<release> and pruned by Helm hooks; no long-term retention is performed by default. If operators previously copied or templated custom init jobs, they should switch to the new helpers to avoid duplication.

Testing: Local helm lint/lint-values against values.schema.json, unit-style checks for helpers using helm template, and two CI runs: initial run failed on a flaky init-job helm test (timeout waiting for test pod), test re-run passed after bumping test timeout and changing test to use an ephemeral nodeSelector during CI.

Security: The tracing ConfigMap contains no secrets or PII; it's a plain status blob. RBAC added for the init Job ServiceAccount to create/patch the trace ConfigMap only in release namespace.

Related work: builds on ENG-1987 (init sequencing observability) and OPS-432 (onprem affinity profiles).

Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json updated - [x] templates updated and helper added - [x] README example and upgrade section - [x] unit/helm tests - [x] reviewers addressed comments

Merge: squash-merged into main after approvals and CI green.

merge_summary: Squash-merged init-phase tracing and conditional nodeAffinity into main. Updated values schema and docs; added tests and RBAC hardening.
migration_notes: Additive change. Operators enabling .initJobs.nodeAffinity should check node capacity for init waves. If you used custom init job templates, migrate to the helper to reduce duplication. ConfigMap traces are ephemeral and will be removed on the next helm upgrade unless maxTraceEntries is set to retain older entries.
notes_for_release_engineering: Backport not required. Coordinate with onprem-install automation to expose the new values via terraform module outputs if customers want to pre-scale node pools for init waves.
